# xiaot310-site — 张义廷的个人研究主页 + 本地工作台

> Owner: 张义廷 (Yiting ZHANG), GitHub xiaot310, Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
> Public site: https://xiaot310.github.io/
> Repo: https://github.com/xiaot310/xiaot310.github.io

## What this is

A zero-dependency static personal research site plus a localhost-only research workbench.
The public layer is safe to deploy to GitHub Pages. The local layer is a Python standard-library
server bound to 127.0.0.1, used for files, LaTeX, planning, notes, and literature links.

## Public pages

- / — personal homepage: profile, current focus, research, projects, workbench entry.
- /lab/ice-failure/ — interactive sea-ice failure criteria demo (Canvas 2D + σ3 slice).
- /agent/ — handoff documentation and keyword retrieval.
- /workbench/ — workbench UI. On public hosting it intentionally shows "local service offline".

## Content model

Edit content/site-content.js to add or update public cards:

- profile: name, role, summary, interests
- focus[]: code, title, stage, status, note, tags
- research[]: id, index, title, en, stage, status, summary, tags, detail
- projects[]: id, index, title, en, summary, tags, badge, href, action
- timeline[]: when, title, note

assets/js/home.js renders the cards. Do not copy homepage HTML to add an entry.
Full schema: content/README.md.

## Local workbench

No manual Python window is required on Windows: a Startup shortcut launches pythonw hidden at logon;
start-workbench-hidden.bat starts it on demand. Manual fallback:

    python workbench/server.py
    # http://127.0.0.1:8765/workbench/

Endpoints: /api/status, /api/files, /api/tools, /api/open, /api/reveal,
/api/oc/status, /api/oc/data, /api/oc/config, /api/oc/sync, /api/oc/clear,
/go/latex, /go/draw.
Only 127.0.0.1. Private config workbench/private.json is gitignored and blocked from static access.
Sensitive directories (个人文件, 奖学金, 身份证, 学历, 学位, 宿舍, 比赛) are excluded from scanning.

## OC / Canvas (read-only)

Use a Canvas personal access token (Account -> Settings -> New Access Token) in the OC tab.
No school password is requested or stored. Token lives in workbench/oc.json (gitignored, static 404);
cache lives in workbench/oc-cache.json. The server only calls https://oc.sjtu.edu.cn and never writes to Canvas.
If the school disables token creation, OC sync is unavailable; there is no password fallback.

## Privacy

- Public layer: safe to share; no private files, no LaTeX token, no unpublished data.
- Private layer: local only; not reachable from GitHub Pages.
- GitHub Pages cannot enforce per-user permissions. Real access control requires a backend.
- Do not commit workbench/private.json, workbench/oc.json, oc-cache.json or any personal documents.

## Deployment

Push the public layer to a GitHub Pages repository (recommended: xiaot310.github.io),
Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → main / (root). Keep .nojekyll.
Never upload private.json, oc.json/oc-cache.json, personal files, or preview temp images.
